thread.title: Wall Street Set for Mixed Open Ahead of Fed Rate Decision

author: MT Newswires
title: Wall Street Set for Mixed Open Ahead of Fed Rate Decision
text:
Shutterstock photo US stocks were set for a mixed open on Wednesday as concerns about the US-China trade dispute resurfaced and traders looked ahead to a fresh set of data, culminating in the announcement of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision later in the session.
Oil prices nudged lower with global benchmark Brent Crude down 1.33%, and US crude West Texas Intermediate down 1.16% recently after industry data showed a surprise increase in US crude stockpiles.
Data released at 8:15 am showed private payrolls rose to 219,000 in July based on Automated Data Processing Inc.'s report as compared to previous level of 177,000 and the 173,000 seen by forecasters, according to data compiled by Econoday.
At 9:45 am, the PMI manufacturing index is expected to come in at a final 55.5 for July, practically unchanged from previous level of 55.4.
At 10 am, forecasters see the Institute for Supply Management's manufacturing index coming in 59.5 for July vs prior level of 60.2. Construction spending is seen rising 0.3% in June vs May's 0.4% rise.
At 2 pm, the Federal Open Market Committee is expected to keep its federal funds target range at 1.75% to 2% for a 1.875% implied target.
In equities, shares of Diebold Nixdorf ( DBD ) were 25.6% lower pre-bell after the company swung to a Q2 adjusted loss on lower revenue.
